title: Pairing payload
description: Single-use invitation shown by the Mac and read by the phone through a user-mediated channel (plan 15.2, ADR-0008). Text forms: code 'SYLVIA1-' + base64url(JSON) and link 'sylvia://pair/v1#' + base64url(JSON) (unpadded base64url, payload in the fragment). The phone pins spki_sha256 before it sends invitation_secret. invitation_secret is a credential: it is never logged, persisted, sent to analytics or placed in pasteboard history managed by Sylvia, and the phone clears its temporary pairing state after pairing.

source_id.description: Stable ID of the Mac source.

source_name.description: Name shown on the phone during pairing.

endpoints.description: Addresses to try in order: LAN IP, Bonjour host name, Tailscale IP or MagicDNS name. None of them is a security check; the SPKI pin is.

host.description: DNS name, IPv4 dotted quad or IPv6 literal without brackets.

spki_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the source's TLS certificate. Shown to people as uppercase groups of four.

invitation_secret.description: Unpadded base64url of 16 to 64 random bytes (at least 128 bits; the Mac issues 32 bytes).

expires_at.description: After this instant the invitation is refused by both ends.
